excavation_context.character_description: An adult female grad student working as a museum preparator, long black hair, Asian ethnicity. Wears a yellow tee shirt with a unicorn image worn UNDER a white lab coat, yellow skirt and white sneakers.

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_preparator_6 uses a delicate hand-chisel under strong laboratory spotlights to split flaky layers of buff yellow chalk matrix away from a long, interlocking chain of Elasmosaurus neck vertebrae. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
